text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Transcend anticipated the synergy that 
would arise from competing against strong 
rivals in the Miyako Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She thought that perhaps by clashing with 
her generation rival, Wonder Acute, she 
might find what she has been searching 
for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, data collection must not be 
forgotten either. To grasp the trigger for 
that thrill, Transcend runs in the Miyako 
Stakes!
